units.source_text: 薰君最近才学步。

en.t: Kaoru had only recently learned to walk.

units.source_text: 他无知无识地走近盛笋的盘子旁边，

en.t: Knowing nothing, he toddled over beside the plate piled with bamboo shoots,

units.source_text: 拿起笋来乱抛，

en.t: picked up the shoots and tossed them about wildly,

units.source_text: 或者咬一下就丢了。

en.t: or took one bite and then threw them away.

units.source_text: 源氏笑着说道：“啊，没有规矩！

en.t: Genji laughed and said, "Ah, what bad manners!

units.source_text: 太胡闹了！

en.t: This is too much mischief!

units.source_text: 快把这盘子藏起来吧。

en.t: Quickly hide this plate away.

units.source_text: 爱说坏话的侍女会传出去，

en.t: The maids who love gossip will spread it around,

units.source_text: 说这孩子是个馋嘴儿呢！”

en.t: saying that this child is a little glutton!"

units.source_text: 就抱了这孩子。

en.t: Then he took the child in his arms.

units.source_text: 又说：“这孩子实在长得眉清目秀啊！

en.t: He went on, "This child really has such fine, handsome features!

units.source_text: 也许是我看见的幼儿不多之故吧，

en.t: Perhaps it is because I have not seen many small children,

units.source_text: 以为这点儿年纪的小孩都是无知无识的，

en.t: but I thought children of this age were all ignorant and unknowing,

units.source_text: 这孩子却现在就与众不同，

en.t: yet this child is already different from the rest,

units.source_text: 倒很可担心呢。

en.t: which is actually rather worrying.

units.source_text: 这么一个人在公主等人中间长大起来，

en.t: If such a person grows up among the princesses and the others,

units.source_text: 对于她们和他自己都会发生麻烦呢。

en.t: trouble will surely arise for them and for him as well.

units.source_text: 不过，可怜啊！

en.t: Still, how pitiful!

units.source_text: 这些人长大的时候，我总是看不到了！

en.t: By the time these children grow up, I will surely no longer be here to see it!

units.source_text: 有道是‘年年春至群花放，能否看花命听天’呀！”

en.t: As the saying goes, 'Each year spring comes and flowers bloom; whether one can see them is left to heaven!'"

units.source_text: 说着，注视小公子的脸。

en.t: As he said this, he gazed at the young lord's face.

units.source_text: 众侍女都说：“呀！莫说这不祥的话！”

en.t: All the maids said, "Oh! Please do not say such unlucky things!"

units.source_text: 薰君已出牙齿，常常想咬东西，

en.t: Kaoru had already cut his teeth and often wanted to bite things,

units.source_text: 他紧紧地握住一支笋，流着口涎拼命地咬。

en.t: so he gripped a bamboo shoot tightly and bit it desperately, drooling all the while.

units.source_text: 源氏笑道：“唉，真是个异常的色情儿啊！”

en.t: Genji laughed and said, "Well now, what an unusually sensual little fellow!"

units.source_text: 便把笋拿开，一面吟道：

en.t: Then he took the bamboo shoot away and chanted:
